sloka: तम् अचिन्त्यम् असह्यम् च अद्भुतम् लोम हर्षणम् ।ददृशुः सर्व भूतानि सागरे सेतु बन्धनम् ॥६-२२-७६॥।।
transliteration: tam acintyam asahyam ca adbhutam loma harṣaṇam ।dadṛśuḥ sarva bhūtāni sāgare setu bandhanam ॥6-22-76॥।।

translations.english: The monkeys were jumping about here and there roaring (in joy). All creatures witnessed the bridge that was inconceivable, marvellous, thrilling, and impossible to build constructed in the sea.
